prompt: Using a stream that ends in an Optional, find the longest word (length >= 2) that reads the same forwards and backwards ignoring case; ties go to the first such word in the list. Complete longestPalindromicWord.
explanation: Several stream terminals produce an Optional precisely because the pipeline may filter everything away -- an empty result is a normal outcome, not an error. reduce with a two-argument accumulator is the key trick here: keeping 'best' unless 'next' is STRICTLY longer means an equal-length later word never replaces an earlier one, which implements the first-on-ties rule (Stream.max makes no such promise). The palindrome test itself is easiest with StringBuilder.reverse on a lowercased copy.
hints: First filter: w.length() >= 2. Second filter: the word equals its own reversal after lowercasing (StringBuilder has reverse()).
End the stream with reduce((best, next) -> ...) -- it returns Optional<String> and is empty when nothing survived the filters.
Inside the reducer, replace best only when next.length() > best.length(); using >= would hand ties to the LAST word instead of the first.
